title: Add Bhajan Library, Holy Books Audio, Vrat Katha, Admin CMS, New Shop Categories & Devotional Mantras

requirements.text: Extend the Spiritual Shop backend data by adding new product categories and seeding at least 20 additional products: Rudraksha (individual bead types: 1-mukhi through 14-mukhi, Gauri Shankar, Ganesha, Siddha Rudraksha — each as a separate product with name, description, category='Rudraksha', price, benefits, astrological purpose); Nav Grah Photo Murti (all 9 planetary deity idols: Surya, Chandra, Mangal, Budh, Guru, Shukra, Shani, Rahu, Ketu — each as a separate product with category='Nav Grah Murti'); Nav Grah Yatra Photos (pilgrimage photo prints for the 9 Nav Grah temples, category='Nav Grah Yatra'); Devi-Devta Photo Yatra (deity yatra photo collection for major deities: Durga, Lakshmi, Saraswati, Kali, Shiva, Vishnu, Krishna, Ram, Hanuman, Ganesh — category='Devi Devta Yatra'). All products must be accessible through the existing getProducts, getProductById, and addToCart/checkout flows.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 20 new products are seeded across the four new categories
Each product has name, description, category, price, benefits, and astrological purpose fields
New categories appear as filter options in the Spiritual Shop frontend
Existing cart and Stripe checkout flow works for new products

requirements.text: In the frontend Spiritual Shop page (frontend/src/pages/SpiritualShop.tsx), add the four new product categories — Rudraksha, Nav Grah Murti, Nav Grah Yatra, and Devi Devta Yatra — to the category filter tabs/buttons so users can browse and filter products by these categories. Ensure product cards, detail pages, and add-to-cart flow work identically to existing categories.
acceptanceCriteria: Four new category filter options appear in the shop filter bar
Filtering by each new category shows the correct seeded products
Product detail pages for new products display correctly
Add to cart and checkout works for new products

requirements.text: Add Nav Grah mantras for all 9 planets (Surya, Chandra, Mangal, Budh, Guru/Brihaspati, Shukra, Shani, Rahu, Ketu) and at least 10 major Devi-Devta mantras (e.g., Durga Mantra, Lakshmi Mantra, Saraswati Mantra, Ganesh Mantra, Shiva Panchakshara, Vishnu Mantra, Krishna Mantra, Hanuman Mantra, Ram Mantra, Kali Mantra) as new seeded entries in the backend devotional content store. Each entry must have title, deity, type='Mantra', full Sanskrit text with Hindi/English transliteration, and language tag. These entries must appear in the existing Devotional Content Library page under the Mantras tab.
acceptanceCriteria: 9 Nav Grah mantras are seeded in the backend
At least 10 Devi-Devta mantras are seeded in the backend
All new mantras appear in the Devotional Library under the Mantras tab
Each mantra card shows full text with verse formatting when clicked
Search/filter by deity works for new mantras

requirements.text: Add a dedicated Bhajan Library page (frontend/src/pages/BhajanlLibrary.tsx) as a standalone section separate from the existing Devotional Content Library. The page must feature a full music player UI with play/pause, next track, previous track, playlist queue display, repeat mode, and shuffle mode controls. Pre-load at least 12 mock bhajan entries (title, artist/deity, duration placeholder, lyrics text, placeholder audio URL) rendered as a playlist. Include both a typing search bar and a voice search button (using Web Speech API SpeechRecognition, with graceful fallback if unsupported) to filter the bhajan list by title or deity. The player should show currently playing track name, a progress bar (non-functional/mock for placeholder audio), and track artwork placeholder. Add a 'Bhajan Library' nav link in the main Layout header and footer.
acceptanceCriteria: Bhajan Library page is accessible at /bhajan-library route
Full player controls (play/pause, next, prev, repeat, shuffle) are present and functional in UI state
At least 12 bhajan entries pre-loaded as mock content
Typing search filters the playlist in real-time
Voice search button triggers SpeechRecognition and populates search field
Currently playing track name and progress bar are displayed
Nav link appears in header and footer

requirements.text: Add a dedicated Vrat Katha page (frontend/src/pages/VratKatha.tsx) at route /vrat-katha. Seed at least 10 Vrat Katha entries in the backend with: title, vrat/festival name (e.g., Ekadashi Katha, Solah Somvar Katha, Satyanarayan Katha, Ganesh Chaturthi Katha, Navratri Katha, Karva Chauth Katha, Pradosh Katha, Shivratri Katha, Janmashtami Katha, Diwali Lakshmi Puja Katha), full story text (mock placeholder paragraphs in Hindi/English), audio URL (placeholder), and festival type. The frontend page displays katha entries in a card grid. Clicking a card opens a detail view showing the full story text with paragraph formatting and an audio player bar (play/pause, with placeholder audio source). Add 'Vrat Katha' to the main nav and footer links.
acceptanceCriteria: Vrat Katha page accessible at /vrat-katha
At least 10 katha entries seeded in the backend
Card grid displays all kathas
Detail view shows full story text and audio player controls
Audio player has play/pause button (placeholder audio)
Nav and footer links updated

requirements.text: Add a dedicated Holy Books Audio page (frontend/src/pages/HolyBooksAudio.tsx) at route /holy-books. Seed the backend with at least 12 holy book entries covering all major Hindu texts: Bhagavad Gita (18 chapters as tracks), Ramcharitmanas (7 Kandas), Shrimad Bhagavatam (overview + selected cantos), Rigveda (sample suktas), Samaveda, Yajurveda, Atharvaveda, Hanuman Chalisa (full path recitation), Sundarkand, Durga Saptashati (13 chapters), Vishnu Sahasranama, and Shiva Mahimna Stotram. Each entry has: bookTitle, chapter/track title, shloka/verse text (mock Sanskrit + transliteration), audioUrl (placeholder), bookCategory (Veda/Purana/Stotra/Epic), and trackNumber. The frontend page has a sidebar/accordion list of books with their chapters. Selecting a chapter loads it in a central music-player panel with play/pause, next chapter, previous chapter, chapter list navigation, and the shloka text displayed below the player. Add 'Holy Books' to main nav and footer.
acceptanceCriteria: Holy Books page accessible at /holy-books
At least 12 books seeded with chapters/tracks
Sidebar lists all books with expandable chapter lists
Selecting a chapter shows its shloka text and audio player
Player has play/pause, next chapter, previous chapter controls
Nav and footer links updated

requirements.text: Add an Admin CMS section as a separate password-gated page (frontend/src/pages/AdminCMS.tsx) at route /admin-cms, distinct from the existing AstrologerDashboard. It must require a hardcoded password (e.g., 'admin2024') entered in a gate form before access is granted. The CMS has three tabs: (1) Bhajan Library Management — admin can add a new bhajan (title, deity, artist, lyrics text, audio file upload converted to base64) and view/delete existing bhajan entries; (2) Vrat Katha Management — admin can add/edit/delete katha entries (title, festival name, story text, audio file upload as base64); (3) Holy Books Management — admin can add new book chapters (bookTitle, chapterTitle, shloka text, audio file upload as base64, bookCategory). Audio files uploaded via the CMS are stored as base64 Text in the Motoko backend. Backend must expose update/create/delete endpoints for bhajan, vrat katha, and holy book audio entries accessible only with an admin principal check or a simple flag.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin CMS page at /admin-cms requires password entry to access
Three tabs: Bhajan Library, Vrat Katha, Holy Books
Admin can add new bhajan entries with audio file upload (base64)
Admin can add/edit/delete vrat katha entries with audio upload
Admin can add holy book chapters with audio upload
Uploaded audio stored as base64 Text in Motoko backend
CMS is separate from the existing AstrologerDashboard
Link to Admin CMS added in footer or a discreet admin navigation area

requirements.text: Extend the Motoko backend (backend/main.mo) to add stable storage and CRUD operations for: (1) BhajanEntry type (id, title, deity, artist, lyricsText, audioBase64, createdAt); (2) VratKathaEntry type (id, title, festivalName, storyText, audioBase64, createdAt); (3) HolyBookEntry type (id, bookTitle, chapterTitle, shlokaText, audioBase64, bookCategory, trackNumber, createdAt). Expose query functions: getBhajans(), getVratKathas(), getHolyBookEntries(bookTitle: Text) and update functions: addBhajan(...), updateBhajan(...), deleteBhajan(id), addVratKatha(...), updateVratKatha(...), deleteVratKatha(id), addHolyBookEntry(...), deleteHolyBookEntry(id). Seed initial mock data for all three types matching the frontend requirements (REQ-17, REQ-18, REQ-19).
acceptanceCriteria: Stable variables for bhajans, vrat kathas, and holy book entries defined
CRUD functions for all three types are callable
getBhajans() returns seeded mock bhajan entries
getVratKathas() returns seeded mock katha entries
getHolyBookEntries(bookTitle) filters by book
addBhajan/addVratKatha/addHolyBookEntry accept base64 audio field
No breaking changes to existing actor interface

requirements.text: Add React Query hooks in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts for the new backend endpoints: useBhajans(), useVratKathas(), useHolyBookEntries(bookTitle), useAddBhajan(), useUpdateBhajan(), useDeleteBhajan(), useAddVratKatha(), useUpdateVratKatha(), useDeleteVratKatha(), useAddHolyBookEntry(), useDeleteHolyBookEntry(). These hooks follow the same pattern as existing hooks in that file.
acceptanceCriteria: All new hooks exported from useQueries.ts
Query hooks fetch from backend actor using useActor pattern
Mutation hooks invalidate relevant query caches on success
Hooks follow identical patterns to existing ones in the file

requirements.text: Update the main App.tsx router to add routes for the four new pages: /bhajan-library (BhajanLibrary), /vrat-katha (VratKatha), /holy-books (HolyBooksAudio), /admin-cms (AdminCMS). Update the Layout.tsx navigation header to include links for 'Bhajan Library', 'Vrat Katha', and 'Holy Books' in the appropriate nav section (devotional/content group). Update the footer in Layout.tsx to include all four new section links. Update the Home.tsx landing page to add CTA cards or quick-access buttons for Bhajan Library, Vrat Katha, and Holy Books in the features/quick-access section.
acceptanceCriteria: All four new routes are registered in App.tsx
Header nav includes Bhajan Library, Vrat Katha, Holy Books links
Footer includes links to all four new sections
Home page features section shows CTAs for the new sections
Admin CMS link is accessible (can be in footer or admin area)

constraints: All Motoko logic must remain in backend/main.mo — no new files for backend logic
Audio files must be stored as base64 Text in Motoko stable storage — no external file hosting or CDN
Frontend immutable paths (useInternetIdentity.ts, useActor.ts, main.tsx, components/ui) must not be modified
New Admin CMS must be a separate page/route from the existing AstrologerDashboard
Do not break or modify any existing backend stable variables or query/update function signatures
nonGoals: Real audio file streaming or external audio CDN integration
Live AstrologyAPI.com or Prokerala API integration (already a placeholder)
Any changes to existing Numerology, Reports, Astrologer, or Panchang sections beyond what is specified
